text:
ITEM 1 | Dark green curly leafy greens (kale-like), finely shredded and tousled, with pale whitish-green stem pieces and a few flat pale shavings on top, piled in a loose mound covering roughly 20% of the plate's lower right area, about 10 cm across and 3-4 cm tall, slightly glossy from dressing | 110
ITEM 2 | Golden-yellow roasted squash cubes with browned edges and dark green skin patches, about 2-3 cm pieces, dry-looking surfaces, scattered in a cluster on the left-center of the plate, about 3 cm tall at most | 80
ITEM 3 | Sliced pale green zucchini or courgette rounds and half-moons with darker green skin and slight char marks, a few pieces about 4-5 cm across, lying flat near the top left of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Small pieces of bright red roasted pepper, soft and slightly glossy, about 2 cm each, two or three pieces tucked beside the zucchini | 15
ITEM 5 | Pale pinkish-brown sliced meat with fibrous grain and moist juicy surface, lightly browned edges, in irregular slices about 5-6 cm long and 1 cm thick, sitting in the upper center of the plate alongside mushroom pieces | 90
ITEM 6 | Brown sautéed mushroom pieces, glossy with oil, irregular shapes about 2-3 cm, mixed among the sliced meat at the top center | 25
ITEM 7 | Breaded chicken-style strips with golden-tan crumb coating, slightly crisp and dry-looking, two or three strips about 8-10 cm long and 2 cm wide, stacked diagonally at the upper right edge of the plate | 110
ITEM 8 | Fresh green herb leaves (flat, bright green, like basil or spinach leaves) scattered in small pieces across the top and middle of the plate, about 1-2 cm each, slightly wilted | 5
